title: Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Summer Dream Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Summer Dream brings a soft, easy-going fruit mix with gentle sweetness and a clean finish. It’s a laid-back profile suited to all-day vaping. Designed for use with the Hayati Ultra 25K Prefilled Pod Kit, the pack combines a 2ml prefilled pod with two 10ml auto-refilling containers so you can enjoy long-range MTL performance without manual top-ups or coil changes. A mesh coil paired with 20mg Nic Salt delivers smooth vapour, clear flavour and quick nicotine satisfaction in a compact, low-upkeep setup. How to Set Up Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Pods Step 1 Remove all protective seals from the 2ml pod and both 10ml refill containers. Step 2 Click the 2ml pod into the mouthpiece module. Step 3 Align and click up to two 10ml auto-refilling containers into the mouthpiece. Step 4 Insert the assembled unit into the device. Step 5 Allow a short moment for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set!
